bio: Syd Gris is a San Francisco-based DJ, event producer, and licensed clinical psychologist (doctorate in clinical psychology) who works with foster children in the Bayview Hunter Point area. He founded Opel Productions in 2002 for benefit-driven underground dance events, and in 2003 co-founded Opulent Temple with Rich Martin, described as one of Burning Man's biggest sound camp productions. He has opened and closed for artists including Tiesto, Moby, Paul Oakenfold, and Underworld, playing a range from electro house and breaks to progressive and tech-trance.
notable_collaborations: Has opened/closed for Tiesto, Moby, Paul Oakenfold, Underworld, Armin van Buuren, Ferry Corsten, Markus Schulz, Stanton Warriors, Adam Freeland, and Meat Katie
burning_man_history: Co-founded Opulent Temple in 2003, described as arguably Burning Man's biggest sound camp production; has played many sets at Burning Man over the years as part of that camp.

bio: Razing Prophet is a psychedelic DJ based in Guadalajara, Mexico who has spent 17 years working in visionary/psytrance-adjacent music (darkpsy, forest, hi-tech, psycore). Early exposure to Infected Mushroom inspired his path as a DJ and visual artist, and he cites influences including Noise Gust, Psykovsky, Far East Ghost, Fatal Discord, and Savage Scream. A performance at Psycircus Festival in Guadalajara (2023) was a personal milestone, played in front of friends and family.

Moldover (Matthew Moldover, b. 1980) is an electronic musician and instrument designer based in San Francisco, credited as a pioneer and namer of "controllerism." He studied electronic music composition at Berklee College of Music (1998-2002), performed with bands in New York City, and relocated to San Francisco in 2008 after a transformative 2003 Burning Man performance. He is known for building custom performance instruments including the Mojo, Robocaster, Octamasher, and Guitar Wing.
notable_releases: Moldover (2009, self-titled, with 'playable packaging'); Say It - Remix EP (2014); Four Track (2016, included playable packaging piece 'Voice Crusher'); Friendly Fire Mixtape (2018)
notable_collaborations: Mickey Hart / Grateful Dead (RAMU project, 2016-2019); instrument collaborations with 60 Works Controllers, Visionary Instruments, and Livid Instruments
burning_man_history: Played his first set as a solo controllerist at Burning Man in 2003, an experience that directly led to his move to San Francisco in 2008; the Octamasher Jambox (2005) was originally designed as a Burning Man gift.

bio: The Organism is Ukrainian producer Roman Yarmolenko, known for hypnotic bass-driven productions spanning organic and melodic house. He founded the label Organic Tunes, which has topped Indie Dance charts, and his tracks have been championed by Solomun, Dixon, Black Coffee, Ame, Kolsch, DJ Tennis, Dennis Ferrer, Andhim, and Pete Tong on BBC Radio 1. His 2025 album 'Evolution' was released as an audio-visual manifesto about a waste-free future.
notable_releases: Reflection (Disco Halal); Rite EP (2019, with Moscoman); Gypsy EP (Eleatics Records, incl. Tim Engelhardt remix); Roast (2019-2020, Diynamic Music); Evolution (Oct 10, 2025, Organic Tunes, 8-track audio-visual album)
labels: Organic Tunes (own label); also released via Disco Halal, Eleatics Records, and Diynamic Music
notable_collaborations: Moscoman (Rite EP); Tim Engelhardt (remix on Gypsy EP); Aves Volare (featured vocalist on 'Freedom Of Your Mind')
burning_man_history: Made his Burning Man debut on the Mayan Warrior stage in August 2022 and became a regular performer at subsequent Burning Man events; in 2025 created his own camp/art project called 'Tree of Life,' described as an immersive project symbolizing unity, growth, and transformation.

bio: DAWdust (Richard Hartnell) is a genre-fluid, multidisciplinary DJ from the US West Coast who has performed in a dozen countries. He built residencies at Rumors Cabaret in Bellingham, WA and MUA Art Bar in Oakland, CA, was nominated one of 'Bellingham's Best Spinners,' and rose to the top 1% of Twitch streamers during COVID-19 before returning to live venues.
notable_releases: Gnomecoming 2024 (house/disco/funk mix); Kindle Northwest 2024 (psydub/breaks/shanti bass mix); Eine Kleine Stimmungmusik (chillout/lo-fi/downtempo mix)

bio: Todd Spero is a Los Angeles-based DJ who came up as a record collector before discovering the underground electronic scene emerging from LA warehouses in the early 1990s. He teamed up with DJ Wolfie and others to help start the Los Angeles Decompression party and the Los Angeles chapter of Burning Man, serving as the event's music director for 10 years to ensure dance music was represented. He later co-founded Insulin Music with Philip Evans and Zak Brown, running techno-oriented warehouse monthlies and desert events.
labels: Insulin Music (collective/production crew with Philip Evans and Zak Brown)
notable_collaborations: DJ Wolfie (LA Decompression); Philip Evans and Zak Brown (Insulin Music)
burning_man_history: Helped start the Los Angeles Decompression party and the Los Angeles chapter of Burning Man; served as the event's music director for about 10 years.
Live DJ sets released via the Opulent Temple podcast series titled 'Live at Burning Man 2022' and 'Live at Burning Man 2024.'

bio: CHEETATAH (Taraleigh Weathers) is a Burlington, Vermont-based DJ and former professional cheerleader performing 'Electric Disco House,' blending disco grooves, tech house, and jam-band influences into what she calls 'cheeky, sweaty, glitter-soaked adventures.' She also runs a novelty service offering live one-hour DJ sessions in clients' homes while they do chores, an idea drawn from her own experience with ADHD.
notable_collaborations: Supported DJ Logic at Zen Barn (Nov 2024); 'Haus of Sparkle' with DJ Vetica (Oct 2024); opened for Hayley Jane Band (Oct 2024)
burning_man_history: Played multiple sets at Burning Man 2024: an ambient guided-meditation set and a high-energy set at Playa Penthouse (Aug 27 and 30, 2024), plus a set at Spanky's Wine Bar (Aug 31, 2024).

bio: LIDIYA (Lidiya Dervisheva) is a Bulgarian-born, San Francisco-based DJ/producer specializing in melodic house and indie dance music, performing as part of the Titanic's End collective.
burning_man_history: Publicly affiliated (per her Instagram bio) with Titanic's End, the well-known Burning Man mutant-vehicle/sound-camp collective; no independently confirmed record of a specific on-playa performance by her personally.

bio: Millad is a French DJ/producer from Paris who grew up under the influence of jazz, funk, and hip hop, and discovered electronic music in the 1990s during trips to visit family in England.

Gilarden is a San Francisco-based DJ/producer and founder of the Love Cartel collective. His sound blends North African and Middle Eastern house influences with indie techno, and he frames his musical gatherings as 'sacred spaces for self-exploration, unity, and human connection.'
notable_releases: Humano (single); Im Lo; Time Will Heal (and a Time Will Heal - Mixed version)
notable_collaborations: Has shared stages with Polo & Pan, Bonobo, Blond:ish, WhoMadeWho, and Mita Gami

burning_man_history: SoundCloud release documents a live DJ set streamed from the El Borg art car at Burning Man on August 31, 2024.

bio: RAMZi is the solo project of Montreal-based multidisciplinary artist Phoebe Guillemot, active since 2012, blending electronic elements with acoustic instrumentation, processed voices, and evolving soundscapes into what she frames as an alternate ecosystem shaped by nature and technology, nostalgia and futurism. She founded her own label, FATi Records, in 2018 and has released fourteen albums across her career.
notable_releases: Hyphea (2022, Music From Memory); Feu Follets (2023, FATi Records); Moon Tan (2024, FATi Records)
labels: FATi Records (own label, founded 2018); also released via Music From Memory, Total Stasis, Mood Hut, RVNG Intl., and 12th Isle
